item.title: Newity on the hunt for new bank partners
item.description: The Chicago-based lender service provider, which has helped build Northeast Bank in Maine into an SBA powerhouse, has expanded its capacity with an AI-driven technology upgrade.

item.title: OCC's GENIUS implementation draft rule keeps yield on the table
item.description: While the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency's recently published stablecoin rule bars stablecoin issuers from offering yield on holdings, there is enough wiggle room in the proposal — and unfinished business in Congress and the courts — for rewards to ultimately be accepted.

item.title: Kraken and Morgan Stanley are playing in each other's backyards
item.description: Morgan Stanley wants to get into crypto, and Kraken is getting inside the Fed. Plus Banco Santander faces a dilemma, and prediction markets make some questionable bets.

item.title: The origin story of stablecoins offers a hint to their future uses
item.description: Noelle Acheson points out that a wander through stablecoin history highlights an overlooked use case likely to be of interest to financial services providers.

item.title: Oil price shock pushes mortgage rates back above 6%
item.description: While this only shows a 2-basis-point rise in the 30-year fixed since last week, the Lender Price product and pricing engine data is 30 basis points higher.

item.title: Wells Fargo fully sheds Fed's massive 2018 enforcement order
item.description: The bank exited the $1.95-trillion asset cap last year, but it had remained subject to the rest of the eight-year-old order.

item.title: Iran war pressures accelerate for banks and payments
item.description: Panelists at a JPMorganChase webinar said oil shipping security is shaky, creating risk of a new wave of inflation that would impact energy finance. Other analysts said the war will create pressure for some parts of the payments industry.

item.title: Fintech giant Revolut pursues US bank charter
item.description: With an application for a U.S. bank charter, the global super app provider aims to expand its offerings and compete with established domestic challengers.

item.title: A community-bank director quits with a parting blast
item.description: Glen Herrick, a veteran bank director, penned a resignation letter criticizing the West Virginia company's executive-compensation policies and what he described as a failure to focus on core profitability.

item.title: Fed's Bowman views Kraken approval as 'pilot program'
item.description: Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman played down the significance of Kraken Financial receiving a master account, saying the central bank is treating it as a pilot program.
